question: If I resolve Invoke the Ancients while I control Parallel Lives and create four tokens instead of two, do I choose a type of counter for each token individually?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: you choose a type of counter separately for each of the four tokens.
expected.answer: If a replacement effect causes you to create more than two tokens, you will make that choice for each of those tokens individually. For example, if you resolve Invoke the Ancients while you control Parallel Lives, you will choose a type of counter for each of the four resulting tokens.
